fusions.name: Unbuckle
fusions.desc: Undoes a strap on the target, dealing 8 damage and stripping 15% of its armour for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Seam Slip
fusions.desc: A weapon strike slipped between the target's plates for 30 damage that ignores armour, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Borrowed Plates
fusions.desc: Straps on pilfered plates: a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. You move 12% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Layer by Layer
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
